source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 7.0 cu. ft. Gas & Electric Dryers Technical Manual (WED4100/WGD4100)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Service Mode entered. Use Service Diagnostics (HMI Test, Sensor Feedback, Diagnostic Cycle) as needed, then continue below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After diagnostic entry, proceed with OEM component test steps.

steps.title: HMI Test
steps.body: Service Diagnostic mode → press Key 1 for HMI Test. Encoder knob test, then button/LED toggle per manual.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Service Diagnostic mode → press Key 1 for HMI Test. Encoder knob test, then button/LED toggle per manual.

steps.title: UI test result
steps.body: All LEDs, buttons, and cycle selector indicators respond with beep?
steps.sourceExcerpt: All LEDs, buttons, and cycle selector indicators respond with beep?

steps.title: ACU and UI connectors seated
steps.body: All connectors fully seated; UI assembly in console?
steps.sourceExcerpt: All connectors fully seated; UI assembly in console?

steps.title: Replace UI assembly
steps.oemOutcome: Replace user interface and housing assembly. If supply OK but UI dead, replace ACU.

steps.title: UI verified
steps.oemOutcome: Buttons and indicators respond in UI Component Test.
